ORDINANCE V OF 2018
ORDINANCE V OF 2018
PUNJAB LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2018
An Ordinance to amend the Punjab Local
Government Act, 2013
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
1st June, 2018]
No.
Legis: 13-3/2003(P-XVI), dated 1.6.2018.---The following Ordinance
promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
information:
It is necessary further to amend the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013
(XVIII of 2013) for extending the term of office of Administrators District
Education Authorities and District Health Authorities in the Punjab.
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and Governor of the
Punjab is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take
immediate action.
In exercise of the powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgates the following Ordinance:
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be cited as the Punjab Local
Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2018.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment in section 30 of Act XVIII of 2013

It is necessary further to amend the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013
(XVIII of 2013) for extending the term of office of Administrators District
Education Authorities and District Health Authorities in the Punjab.
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and Governor of the
Punjab is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take
immediate action.
In exercise of the powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgates the following Ordinance:
2. Amendment in
section 30 of Act XVIII of 2013.---In the Punjab Local
Government Act, 2013 (XVIII of 2013), in section 30, in subsection (3), for the
words "twelve months", the words "two years" shall be
substituted and shall be deemed always to have been so substituted.
